name: quick-opener
title: Quick Opener
description: Open selected paths in your preferred editor, Finder, or Quick Look, with support for SSH paths and URLs.
author: harssha_vardan

commands.name: open-selected-path
commands.title: Open Selected Path
commands.subtitle: Quick Opener
commands.description: Open selected text (or clipboard) as a path in the right app — Zed for code, Finder for folders, Quick Look for media

commands.name: open-path
commands.title: Open Path...
commands.subtitle: Quick Opener
commands.description: Inspect a path from selection/clipboard and choose how to open it

preferences.name: editor
preferences.title: Editor for Code & Text
preferences.description: Where code, config and text files open

preferences.name: mediaMode
preferences.title: Images & Video
preferences.description: Quick Look first, or open directly in Preview / default app

preferences.name: sshTerminal
preferences.title: SSH Terminal (for VPS folders/files)
preferences.description: Where SSH sessions open for remote folders, and the fallback for remote files

preferences.name: defaultSshHost
preferences.title: Default VPS (optional)
preferences.description: e.g. root@myvps — adds an Open-on-VPS action for missing local paths. Leave empty to auto-use the first Host in ~/.ssh/config

preferences.name: fallbackToClipboard
preferences.title: Fall back to clipboard
preferences.description: If no text is selected, try the clipboard
preferences.label: Use clipboard when selection is empty
